lalonde1986.note: Full text: scan of the published AER article (pp. 604-620) hosted by a third party (gwern.net), text extracted with pdftotext. Metadata (vol 76, no 4, pp 604-620, Sept 1986) from IDEAS/RePEc https://ideas.repec.org/a/aea/aecrev/v76y1986i4p604-20.html. No DOI (JSTOR stable 1806062). Table 5 read: experimental male impact $886 (SE 476), 1982 dollars; CPS-SSA definition in footnote, p. 611-612.

dehejia1999.note: Full text read is the NBER Working Paper 6586 version (PDF dated June 1998), not the JASA typeset article (tandfonline returned 403). Journal metadata from Crossref. Numbers cited (Tables 1-3) are from the working paper; the benchmark $1,794 is corroborated by smith2005 (Table 1), imbens2025 and dehejia2002.

dehejia2002.note: Full text read is NBER Working Paper 6829 (PDF dated Dec 1998). Journal metadata from Crossref and IDEAS (https://ideas.repec.org/a/tpr/restat/v84y2002i1p151-161.html, abstract read). Table 2 numbers are from the working paper and may differ from the published REStat tables.

dehejiadata.note: Data documentation page fetched 2026-11-18 (and directory index https://users.nber.org/~rdehejia/data/). States file names, N (nswre74_treated 185, nswre74_control 260, cps_controls 15,992), column order, and that LaLonde gave permission to publish; no explicit licence. Data files themselves were not downloaded by the Scout.

smith2005.note: Full text: 'Article in press' PDF of the J. Econometrics article (pages 305-353 headers), pdftotext. Metadata from Crossref. Tables 1 and 5 read.

dehejia2005.note: Full text: 'Article in press' PDF on the author's site; abstract and introduction read. Metadata from Crossref and IDEAS.

imbens2015.note: Full text read is NBER Working Paper 19959 (March 2014), prepared for JHR. Journal metadata from Crossref. Section 4 (three-stage strategy) and Section 6.3, Tables 20-22 (non-experimental Lalonde data, thousands of dollars) read.

imbens2025.note: Full text: arXiv:2406.00827v3 (27 May 2025), 'Journal of Economic Perspective, Forthcoming' version, pdftotext. Published metadata from Crossref (JEP 39(4):173-201) and the AEA article page https://www.aeaweb.org/articles?id=10.1257/jep.20251440 (abstract read; the AEA page lists pages 173-202, Crossref 173-201). Earlier circulated title: 'LaLonde (1986) after Nearly Four Decades: Lessons Learned' (SSRN 10.2139/ssrn.4849285).

xu2024tutorial.note: Replication tutorial page for imbens2025, fetched 2026-11-18. Tables B1 and B2 (LDW-CPS1 ATT and placebo estimates with robust SEs) read from the page. Numbers are the tutorial's; they need not equal the figure in the published JEP article.

advani2019.note: Full text: arXiv:1809.09527v2 (17 Apr 2019). Published metadata from Crossref. Summary and Section 4 (NSW-CPS application) read.

athey2024.note: Full text: arXiv:1909.02210v3 (July 2020). Published metadata (J. Econometrics 240(2), article 105076, March 2024) from Crossref. Abstract and Section 3 (LDW data) read.

abadie2011.note: Metadata from Crossref; abstract from IDEAS/RePEc (mentions application to the NSW data of LaLonde 1986 and an NSW-based simulation). Full text not read.

crump2009.note: Abstract read from NBER Technical Working Paper 330 (2006), circulated as 'Moving the Goalposts: Addressing Limited Overlap in the Estimation of Average Treatment Effects by Changing the Estimand'. Published Biometrika metadata from Crossref; published article not read. The [0.1, 0.9] rule is stated in the WP abstract and attributed to Crump et al. (2009) in imbens2025.

rubin2008.note: Full text: arXiv:0811.1640v1, which carries the AoAS 2(3):808-840 header and DOI. Abstract and Section 1-2 read.

cook2008.note: Full text: copy of the published JPAM article (27 pp., page headers 724-750) hosted on the Columbia statmodeling blog, pdftotext. Metadata from Crossref. Read: abstract, 'Enumerating the Criteria' (criterion 4: analysts blind to each other's results, p. 728), discussion of Aiken et al. (1998) and Shadish, Clark and Steiner (in press) (pp. 739-740).

weidmann2021.note: Full text: arXiv:1910.07091 preprint, titled 'Lurking inferential monsters? Quantifying bias in non-experimental evaluations of school programs'. Published metadata (JPAM 40(3):964-986; Crossref issued 2020-07-13 online) and the published title from Crossref.
